Only the following features connect to third-party services, and only when you trigger them yourself:
only for local reminders that you switch on yourself (end of rest, training, water, meals); they're created on the device, not via a server.

Only if you explicitly consent under “Leaderboard” does the app send data to our server: a random user ID (without email address or real name), your nickname and avatar, for each training day the number of completed exercises and whether the planned workout was complete, your training streak, your best set per exercise (weight, reps and the estimated max weight derived from them), your fastest run of 3 km or more in the last 60 days (date, distance and duration), the results of counted break games with start and end time, and the friends groups you create or join. If you set your gym under “Friends”, your current location is sent to the server once, only to find gyms nearby – it is not stored. What is stored is the gym's name and location (rounded to about 10 m), that you train there and when you last changed it. Optionally, sex, age group and body weight are added so that you're only compared with similar people. From this, strength and running scores, the monthly game season, the overall rating and the monthly league are calculated. Other participants see your nickname and avatar together with your score points (strength, running, games, overall) and rankings in the leaderboards, as well as your points in your league group. Members of your friends groups and everyone who has set the same gym also see your league tier and monthly points. Others don't see the gym's location, only its name and – when choosing on site – the approximate distance. Others don't see individual weights, running times or game results. Others don't see sex, age group and body weight. Unusual values and reports from other participants are stored to check for abuse. The server is operated by Supabase Pte. Ltd. (65 Chulia Street #38-02/03, OCBC Centre, Singapore 049513) as a processor; the data centre is in Paris (EU). Where Supabase accesses data from outside the EU, this is based on the EU standard contractual clauses. The legal basis is your explicit consent (Art. 6(1)(a), Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR). You can withdraw it at any time by ending your participation under “Data & backup” – all leaderboard data on the server is then deleted immediately.

Cook the rice according to the packet (about 15 min). Cut the chicken breast into strips, season with salt and pepper and fry in olive oil for 6–8 min until golden. Cut the broccoli into florets and steam for 5 min or cook in salted water. Serve everything together, seasoned with paprika or lemon juice if you like.

Cook the rice according to the packet. Cut the chicken breast into thin strips and fry in oil in a wok over high heat for 5 min. Add the frozen stir-fry vegetables and fry for 5 min. Deglaze with soy sauce and serve with the rice.

Cook the rice according to the packet. Cut the chicken breast into strips, season with salt, pepper, paprika and cumin and fry in a pan for 6–8 min until cooked through. Rinse the kidney beans and warm briefly; dice the pepper. Slice the avocado. Put the rice in a bowl and top with chicken, beans, pepper and avocado.

Cook the rice according to the packet. Rinse the chickpeas and bring to the boil in a pot with the coconut milk and about 50 ml water. Season with curry powder, turmeric, salt and pepper and simmer for 8 min. Add the spinach and let it wilt for 2 min. Serve with the rice.

Cook the rice according to the packet. Dice the pepper and fry in a pot for 3 min. Add passata and rinsed kidney beans and season with chilli, cumin, paprika, salt and pepper. Simmer for 15 min and serve on the rice.

Cook the rice according to the packet. Fry the turkey mince in a pot until crumbly, dice the pepper and fry it too. Add passata and rinsed kidney beans and season with chilli, cumin and salt. Simmer for 15 min and serve on the rice.

Cook the rice according to the packet. Fry the beef mince in a pan without extra fat until crumbly and season with salt, pepper, paprika and cumin. Rinse the kidney beans, add them with the sweetcorn to the mince and warm for 3–4 min. Serve on the rice.

Cook the rice according to the packet. Drain and dice the tofu and fry in a non-stick pan for 6–8 min until crispy. Add the vegetable mix and fry for 5 min. Season with soy sauce and serve on the rice.
Cook the rice according to the packet. Fry the stir-fry vegetables in a hot pan or wok for 5 min. Add the prawns and fry for 3–4 min until pink. Deglaze with soy sauce and serve with the rice.
